extDescription.message: Show the corresponding original text after browser page translation.

popupPageTranslated.message: Translation detected. Existing originals are protected.

popupPageUnknown.message: The current text source is uncertain. Changed old records will not be shown.

popupPageReady.message: Ready. The currently loaded content has been captured.

popupPageNotReady.message: Not prepared. Capture the original page before translating.

popupRecoveryDescription.message: Use these only when the page state is uncertain or the layout is affected.

popupErrorUnsupportedPage.message: This page is unsupported. Open an HTTP/HTTPS page.

popupErrorNoActiveTab.message: Unable to get the active tab.

popupErrorContentScriptNotReady.message: The content script failed to initialize.

popupErrorPreprocessNoAck.message: Original capture did not finish. Wait for the page to load and retry.

popupErrorRestoreNoAck.message: The page structure could not be restored.

popupErrorStatusNoAck.message: The current page status could not be read.

popupErrorLoading.message: The page is still loading. Try again shortly.

popupErrorBusy.message: The page is being processed. Try again shortly.

popupErrorAlreadyTranslated.message: Translation is detected. Restore the source language in the browser first; translated text cannot be captured as original.

popupErrorUncertainSource.message: The text source is uncertain. If the browser is showing the source language, use the recapture action below.

popupErrorPrepareFailed.message: Original capture failed. Reload the page and try again.

popupErrorToggleNoAck.message: The page did not confirm the feature update.

popupStatusPreprocessDone.message: The entire loaded page is ready. You can translate now.

popupStatusRestoreDone.message: Extension markers were removed; the page language was not changed. Use browser translation to restore the source language.

tooltipCopyFailed.message: Copy failed. Select the original text and copy it manually.

tooltipPartialMissing.message: [Some selected text has no captured original.]

tooltipAllMissing.message: [No captured original is available for this selection.]
